title: Depression and Discouragement
definition: Depression and discouragement refer to seasons of deep emotional heaviness, sorrow, weariness, hopelessness, or loss of heart that affect a person's thoughts, emotions, and spiritual life.
summary: God meets discouraged and heavy-hearted people with compassion, truth, and help.
christFocus: Jesus is compassionate toward the weary, burdened, and brokenhearted, offering grace and rest to those who come to Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Scripture contains many examples of faithful believers who experienced deep discouragement, fear, exhaustion, and despair. Depression is not automatically evidence of weak faith or spiritual failure. God often meets His people in their darkest moments through His presence, His Word, prayer, wise counsel, and the encouragement of other believers. Though healing may take time, believers are never abandoned by God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Those struggling with depression often feel ashamed, misunderstood, or isolated. Understanding God's compassion helps believers reject hopelessness and continue seeking help, truth, and support.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Speak honestly with God about your struggles. Remain connected to trusted believers even when you feel like withdrawing. Seek wisdom, prayer, and appropriate help when needed. Remember that your standing before God rests on Christ's finished work, not your emotional condition.
